name: Cut Off 1
definition: Information that describes a netting cut off held at a central system.

CutOffUpdateIdentification.name: Cut Off Update Identification
CutOffUpdateIdentification.definition: Identification for the updated netting cut off.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency linked to the netting cut off.

CutOffTime.name: Cut Off Time
CutOffTime.definition: Cut off time value for the netting cut off.

ValueDateOffset.name: Value Date Offset
ValueDateOffset.definition: Specifies the offset in business days from the value date from which the netting cut off is to be applied.
